source_recency_conflict: April 2019 hibernation path predates CE; do not call it a CE-specific endpoint on timing alone
conclusions: Old index screenshots document a strictly larger server namespace than the surviving 74-file tree.
A missing backup is an actionable alternate-data recovery target, especially saf_dat_col_BACKUP.html (1.9M), but screenshot size alone cannot prove it differs from other source files.
Five numbered terminal routes exist in original screenshot. Their mere coexistence neither specifies a five-entry selector nor proves that stickers drive them.
Terminal 23 is historically present, but 23 has many other occurrences in the ARG and matching cardinality is not a decoding rule.
No supplied source labels any of the original routes as consuming slash/dash/dot foreground symbols.
